queries:
WITH per_rating AS (
  SELECT rating,
         AVG(rental_rate * 1.0 / rental_duration) AS avg_ratio,
         COUNT(*) AS film_count
  FROM film
  WHERE rental_duration > 5
  GROUP BY rating
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS mean_avg FROM per_rating
)
SELECT p.rating,
       p.avg_ratio,
       p.film_count,
       p.avg_ratio / o.mean_avg AS ratio
FROM per_rating p
CROSS JOIN overall o
WHERE o.mean_avg IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY p.rating;
SELECT rental_duration, COUNT(rental_rate) AS film_count, AVG(rental_rate) AS avg_rental_rate
FROM film
GROUP BY rental_duration;
SELECT title
FROM film
WHERE rental_rate * 1.0 / rental_duration > (SELECT AVG(rental_rate * 1.0 / rental_duration) FROM film);
SELECT rating, COUNT(*) AS films
FROM film
GROUP BY rating
ORDER BY CASE rating
  WHEN 'G' THEN 1
  WHEN 'PG' THEN 2
  WHEN 'PG-13' THEN 3
  WHEN 'R' THEN 4
  WHEN 'NC-17' THEN 5
END;
